caption: The worked example as one chain: a 20 mm object standing 500 mm from a 50 mm lens forms an inverted image 2.22 mm high at v = 55.56 mm. Geometry stops at that image; the same lens then delivers irradiance on the sensor, and exposure turns it into a pixel value.

spec.title: Worked example: f = 50 mm, u = 500 mm
spec.aria: A 20 mm object at 500 mm from a 50 mm lens gives v = 55.56 mm and a 2.22 mm inverted image; that image's radiance becomes sensor irradiance and then a pixel value.
